title: Field update and mail merge fail on LibreOffice files that keep unused even-page headers
symptom: update_fields (Rust, Python), Rust mail_merge and oxoffice docx fields update fail with "source inventory identified 0 of 1 paragraphs in header" when a section references an even-page header or footer while different even and odd pages are off, as LibreOffice writes
workaround: drop the unused even references first: Rust inherit_section_story(i, Header, Even) and inherit_section_story(i, Footer, Even) for each section; Python section.even_page_header.is_linked_to_previous = True and the same for even_page_footer, which make that call; none through the CLI
